why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: Check that you're allowed. The terms shut out anyone who is "a citizen of, a resident of, located in, or domiciled in the United States or any of its territories", along with sanctioned countries. You must be 18 or older, and VPNs are banned.
Open app.metric.xyz , connect a self-custodial EVM wallet and pick Ethereum, BNB Chain or Robinhood Chain. The docs remind you: "Keep enough of the network's gas token to pay for gas."
To swap, choose the tokens and the amount. Metric's quote is listed first, marked with a star, above quotes from other routes. Compare them, approve the token if asked and confirm in your wallet.

To take your money out: "Open your position, choose how much liquidity to remove, review the tokens you will receive, then confirm in your wallet." You may get back a different mix of tokens than you put in.
costs: Swapping adds no fee on top: "Traders pay zero fees on Metric." The cost sits inside the quoted price, plus gas. Providing liquidity means depositing your own tokens, and the curator and Metric take their share of the spread before you get yours. The docs say "Metric's default share is 7.5% of the overall spread", but the terms allow far more: "a protocol-level fee of up to forty percent (40%) of
risks: You can lose all of it. The docs say: "Providing liquidity on Metric is high risk. You can lose your entire deposit." And: "Asset price losses can outweigh Edge." Metric's marketing and its own terms don't agree.
